equations_8_to_10_verdict.cumulative_integral: Positive finite Ic is retained; the vanishing object is its endpoint tail. Assumptions include fixed finite coefficients, eta_c>0 and no earlier singularity.
equations_8_to_10_verdict.force_ratio: Tends to zero for the two stated integrable endpoint powers; the text does not exclude finite-window fits, a joint infinite-cooling limit or simultaneous eta collapse.
equations_8_to_10_verdict.leading_coefficient: The same scalar force balance requires A^3=9 eta_c/2; B14 comparison is about the displayed calculation, not an undocumented implementation.
equations_8_to_10_verdict.subleading_correction: 8/9 and D1=(81/44)Hc*A^(-5/3) are qualified as local frozen-leading-equation results for Hc nonzero; the zero-thermal 4/3 control is separated.
equations_8_to_10_verdict.physical_scope: No corrected full-MHD trajectory, global existence theorem, measured physical exponent, critical cooling threshold or source figure reproduction is claimed.
